message: the TrustManager[] given to SSLContext.init holds a manager of a class the application defines and was not observed coming from a TrustManagerFactory
unique_msg: me.ash.reader.infrastructure.di.OkHttpClientModuleKt:::setupSsl:::SSLContextSpec:::UnsatisfiedConstraint:::the TrustManager[] given to SSLContext.init holds a manager of a class the application defines and was not observed coming from a TrustManagerFactory
detector_site_kind: NOBS: a required origin was not observed (not a positive contradiction)
detector_label_meaning: NOT OBSERVED: the runtime monitor tracks the producers a rule requires by object identity within one process, and saw none for this object. The TrustManager[] given to SSLContext.init holds a trust manager class the application defines. That covers both a manager that accepts every certificate and one that validates; the body of its checkServerTrusted (and the condition under which it is installed) decides which.
detector_expected: a TrustManager[] an observed TrustManagerFactory returned
detector_runtime_observation: Reported in 2 run(s) of the app; each run starts from a clean, read-only emulator. Trust manager class(es) in the array: me.ash.reader.infrastructure.di.OkHttpClientModuleKt$setupSsl$trustManager$2.
